## Research Collaborator, NCL.jl

**Polytechnique Montréal** · Remote · Aug 2026 – present

[NCL.jl](https://github.com/JuliaSmoothOptimizers/NCL.jl) implements a stabilized
augmented-Lagrangian method that reformulates LANCELOT-style subproblems as a short
sequence of nonlinearly constrained problems regularized by residual variables. This
makes it reliable on large problems that violate the LICQ. I am developing an NCL-like
outer-loop implementation of the Superb algorithm (Gould–Orban–Toint, 2003), an
interior-point ℓ₁-penalty method.

## Research Contributor, Q-MAML for HEP at the LHC

**Machine Learning for Science (ML4SCI)** · Remote · Aug 2026 – present

Advisor: Junyong Lee (Yonsei University).

Q-MAML (Quantum Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning) uses a classical "Learner" network to
predict initial parameters for variational quantum circuits. Applied to HIGGS and
quark–gluon jet classification, it gave statistically significant accuracy gains over
classical initialization at every qubit count tested. I am now benchmarking it on ten
HEP lattice Hamiltonians, including the Schwinger model, lattice gauge theories,
scalar field theory and light-nuclei EFT.
